lines.zh: 蹒跚前行，散发阴森光芒
lines.en: Shuffle with eerie glow
Sibilant and heavy footsteps

lines.zh: 我拖着锄头，沿着田埂走。
lines.en: I drag the hoe along the field ridge.
Tusks peeking in darkness

lines.zh: 啃咬木头，发出沉闷声响
lines.en: Chomp wood with dull sound
Muttering in low tone
Feasting on decayed corpse
Swing iron hoe, sparks fly
Stare at player, fierce eyes
Shake body, trying to approach
I walk with a farmer's dragging steps.
That grey robe has worn through.
Standing, eyes vacant
Scanning surroundings, alert
Chewing repeatedly, discontent
Shaking arms, summoning
Holding knives, ready to fight
Staring at ground, looking for traps
My fingers are chewed to the bone.
Gently swaying, waiting
Staring into distance, gaze lost
Muttering softly, to self
Suddenly turns, staring at player

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，步步紧逼
lines.en: Eyes lock on player, closing in
Sibilant, approaching player
Low growl, player notices
Raising iron pick, ready to attack
Warning, player steps back
Tight fangs, fierce eyes
Swinging spear, aiming at player
Extending hands, ready to capture
Approaching, hissing
Weakness spreading...

lines.zh: 这具身体不肯听我使唤。
lines.en: This body won't obey me anymore.
This pain is unbearable...

lines.zh: 附在我身上的东西，缩回去了。
lines.en: Whatever rides me has pulled back inside.
My knees slip in the mud.
Let me lean on the field ridge and breathe.
I can barely lift the hoe now.
Fighting hard...
My fingers can't hold the hoe handle.
Not long now...

lines.zh: 它眼睛赤红，盯着你不停流口水。
lines.en: Its red eyes stare at you, drooling nonstop.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤变得越来越苍白，仿佛吸走了你的生命力。
lines.en: Its skin turns paler, sapping your life force.

lines.zh: 它抓向你，试图用双手束缚你。
lines.en: It lunges at you, trying to restrain you with its hands.

lines.zh: 它轻蔑地笑，仿佛你是它的美味佳肴。
lines.en: It mocks you, treating you like a delicacy.

lines.zh: 它眼神空洞，却对你露出凶残的笑容。
lines.en: Its hollow eyes gleam with savage delight.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶作响，试图用诡异的符文吸引你。
lines.en: It hisses, trying to lure you with eerie runes.

lines.zh: 它用破烂的衣衫遮掩你的视线。
lines.en: It covers you with tattered clothes.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸越来越重，好像要吞噬你。
lines.en: Its breathing grows heavier, ready to devour you.

lines.zh: 它眼中闪过一丝渴望，想要吞噬你。
lines.en: A glint of desire flashes in its eyes, ready to consume you.

lines.zh: 它嘶哑的声音中满是贪婪。
lines.en: Its hoarse voice is filled with greed.

lines.zh: 它突然撞向你，身体如同幽灵般透明。
lines.en: It collides with you, its body transparent like a ghost.

lines.zh: 它撞开你，仿佛被无形的力量驱使。
lines.en: It pushes you aside, driven by an unseen force.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，皮肤紧绷仿佛随时会爆裂。
lines.en: It collides with you, its skin taut as if it might burst.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，身体发出刺耳的吱吱声。
lines.en: It collides with you, producing a high-pitched screech.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，留下一道模糊的身影。
lines.en: It collides with you, leaving a blurry silhouette.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，仿佛从黑暗中挣脱而出。
lines.en: It collides with you, as if breaking free from the darkness.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，身体如同被无形之手操控。
lines.en: It collides with you, its body controlled by an invisible hand.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，仿佛来自另一个世界。
lines.en: It collides with you, as if from another world.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，皮肤表面出现诡异的裂纹。
lines.en: It collides with you, cracks appearing on its skin.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，留下一地破碎的幻影。
lines.en: It collides with you, leaving a ground of shattered illusions.

lines.zh: 它紧盯着对方，眼神充满渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes lock on the other, filled with desire.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，试图吸引对方的注意。
lines.en: It hisses, trying to attract the other's attention.

lines.zh: 它轻轻碰触对方，试图表达爱意。
lines.en: It gently touches the other, expressing affection.

lines.zh: 它眼中闪烁着温柔的光芒。
lines.en: A gentle light glows in its eyes.

lines.zh: 它靠近对方，试图亲密接触。
lines.en: It approaches the other, seeking intimacy.

lines.zh: 它轻轻咬住对方，表达亲密。
lines.en: It gently nips at the other, showing affection.

lines.zh: 它用身体缠住对方，仿佛要融为一体。
lines.en: It wraps itself around the other, as if to merge.

lines.zh: 它眼神温柔，如同爱人般看着对方。
lines.en: Its gaze is tender, like that of a lover.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的呜呜声，表达爱意。
lines.en: It emits a low, woeful sound, expressing affection.

lines.zh: 它靠近对方，轻轻蹭着对方的身体。
lines.en: It approaches the other, gently rubbing against them.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着诡异的绿光
lines.en: Its eyes glow with an eerie green

lines.zh: 它抓起一块发霉的面包
lines.en: It snatches a moldy loaf of bread

lines.zh: 它的皮肤开始剥落，露出苍白的肉
lines.en: Its skin starts to peel, revealing pale flesh
It stares at you, its eyes hollow

lines.zh: 它啃食着一块腐烂的肉
lines.en: It gnaws on a chunk of rotted meat

lines.zh: 它在腐化的土地上爬行
lines.en: It crawls on the corrupted ground
Nothing is under my green robe.

lines.zh: 它的声音沙哑，说话含糊
lines.en: Its voice is hoarse, slurring its words

lines.zh: 它手持一把锈迹斑斑的镰刀
lines.en: It holds a rusted scythe
I stuff the rotten meat into my pocket.
It reaches out with both hands
You become its target
Its gaze turns疯狂
It slowly approaches
Its body twists
Its movements become slow
Its eyes sharpen
It begins to mutter incantations

lines.zh: 它的眼神中透露出贪婪
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with greed

lines.zh: 它向你释放一道幽灵火焰
lines.en: It releases a ghostly flame
The pale demon is behind you.
My hands no longer obey me.
It looks at you through my eyes.

lines.zh: 村长没教过我怎么用镰刀。
lines.en: The village head never taught me the scythe.

lines.zh: 我在挖一条通往下界的路。
lines.en: I am digging a road to the Nether.

lines.zh: 我还会种地，只是不再说话。
lines.en: I still farm. I just don't speak.
Its claws tighten
Its teeth clench harder
Its eyes fix on you more
Its body leans forward

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，准备攻击
lines.en: It hisses, preparing to attack
Its breath quickens
Its expression becomes sinister
Its fingers tremble
Its eyes flash with ferocity

lines.zh: 它在你影子里伸出了手。
lines.en: It reaches out of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我的舌头在念别的名字。
lines.en: My tongue is saying another name.
These bones are no longer mine.
Don't listen to me. Run.

lines.zh: 它的手从我背后伸出来。
lines.en: Its hand comes out of my back.
Will that torch light protect you?
The thing below has woken.

lines.zh: 它借我的耳朵听你的心跳。
lines.en: It listens to your heartbeat through my ears.
Sssssss, red eyes!
Charge at player, sharp teeth!
Waving a ragged sword, roar!

lines.zh: 啃咬村民尸体，贪婪目光！
lines.en: Biting villager corpses, greedy gaze!

lines.zh: 双手紧握木棍，狂乱攻击！
lines.en: Clutching a wooden stick, frenzied attack!
Low growl, approaching!

lines.zh: 撕扯布料，露出苍白皮肤！
lines.en: Tearing cloth, revealing pale skin!

lines.zh: 咆哮着向前冲，手中匕首闪亮！
lines.en: Roaring, charging forward, dagger shining!
Frenzied hacking around!
Fixing gaze on player, ready to bite!
The rusted scythe cuts your hand!
It's not my hand swinging this!
It bit you with my mouth!
Roots from below wrap around you!
I am crying. It is laughing!
Run. I can't hold it back!
Appears in dark corners!
Hatches from Witherholes!
Summoned by Pale Demon!
Wanders in abandoned villages!
Appears on moonlit nights!
Reborn from villager corpses!
Hatches at the edge of graveyards!
Spawns in Pale Warden territory!
Appears at night, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 从苍白恶灵的巢穴中孵化！
lines.en: Hatches from Pale Warden nest!
I'm still wearing a villager's skin.
It let me open my first eye.
Fire burns...
Fell down...
I sink in the water, still muttering.
Explosion hurt...

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我肩上，我歪了歪头。
lines.en: An arrow stands in my shoulder; I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 我的绿袍子被光烧出洞。
lines.en: Light burns holes in my green robe.
Starvation weakens...

lines.zh: 雷光顺着锄柄窜进手心。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the hoe into my palm.
Void took my life...
